headlines.text: 2023 brought us this moment: El Hijo del Vikingo made a statement, debuting in the main event against Kenny Omega, appearing on Dynamite, rated 9.12 ? a genuine showstealer. Originally scheduled for 2021 before Omega's injuries forced its cancellation, this long-awaited dream match finally happened, with Omega picking up the win in one of the most talked-about matches of the year.

Back on this day in 2026, JetSpeed & Mistico vs. Alexander, Clon & Takeshita fought tooth and nail for the AEW World Trios Titles, appearing on Collision, rated 7.02 ? a match that delivered. It was the first title opportunity of Alexander, Clon & Takeshita's career. It was the 50th time the AEW World Trios Titles had been on the line, a genuinely rare milestone for that title. Fresh off their title win, M?stico and JetSpeed turned back an immediate rematch attempt from the Don Callis Family's Alexander, El Clon and Takeshita.
Back on this day in 2024, AEW welcomed Fletcher & Hobbs for the first time as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.76.

secondaries.text: Back on this day in 2025, Briscoe, Hobbs & Romero made a statement, debuting in the main event as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 6.38.
Turning the clock back to 2023: Allin & Sting & Cassidy made their AEW debut as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.46.
It was 2024 when Julia Hart vs. Skye Blue vs. Kris Statlander vs. Willow Nightingale fought it out in a Street Fight match, in the night's main event on Rampage, rated 7.05 ? a solid showing.
